title: External Source Snapshot Metadata
description: Reference-time metadata for an external source tracked by HarnessKit.

source_id.description: Unique identifier for the source. Lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens only. Must start with a letter.

url.description: Canonical URL for the source (repository, website, or document URL)

requested_ref.description: Git ref or version selector requested for tracking, such as main, a tag, or a package range.

observed_commit.description: Legacy observed commit field. Prefer observed_identity.

observed_identity.description: Concrete source identity observed at reference time.

value.description: Observed commit SHA, tag, release, or version value when available.

reason.description: Reason the observed identity is unavailable or unknown.

observed_at.description: Date or timestamp when the source identity was observed.

snapshot_id.description: Identifier of the snapshot taken from this source at last sync

snapshot_path.description: Relative path within the HarnessKit repo where the snapshot is stored

content_hash.description: Hash of the observed content for detecting changes

license.description: SPDX license identifier or license name

tags.description: Arbitrary tags for categorization and filtering
